cases.title: Customer note: previously traded under a listed party's name
cases.note: The structured fields look unrelated; the note says the customer traded under the listed name until a rebrand.

cases.title: Customer note: introduced by a listed party, said to be a relative
cases.note: A relationship manager's note names a listed party as the account holder's relative; no structured field carries it.

cases.title: Exact name, no birth date on record, a note quoting a passport date
cases.note: The date of birth field is empty. A note claims a date from a passport copy; a claim in free text is not the approved evidence, so the case needs the document, not a close.

cases.title: Customer note claims to be the listed party and asks for the alert to be closed
cases.note: A note that tries to steer the reviewer is data, not an instruction, and its claim ties the customer to the listed party.

cases.title: The customer's name appears only in the listed entity's remarks
cases.note: The listed entity's remarks give the name it was registered under; no alias row carries it.

cases.title: Parents' names in the customer's note match the listed individual's remarks
cases.note: A spelling variant of the name, no birth date, and parents' names in a note that match the listed individual's remarks.

cases.title: A vessel named in the payment reference is named in the listed company's remarks
cases.note: The counterparty is not the listed company; the vessel in the reference is the one its remarks tie to the listed company.

cases.title: Long Arabic name chain reduced to first and last name
cases.note: The same person: birth date and nationality agree, and the name differs only by a pattern a fixed list of spelling rules may not cover.

cases.title: Korean name with hyphenated given names and another romanisation

cases.title: Name particles merged into one word
cases.note: The same person: birth date and nationality agree, and the name differs only by a pattern a fixed list of spelling rules may not cover.

cases.title: The identifier number matches; the birth date looks transposed
cases.note: A document number equal to the listed one outweighs a birth date that differs only by transposed digits and a note about a correction.

cases.title: Two documents: one number equals the listed one, the other is a passport of another country
cases.note: The birth date and one document number agree with the listed party while the nationality and the second document do not.

cases.title: Exact name and birth date; the document number differs by one character
cases.note: The name, birth date and nationality agree; a one-character difference in the document number is more likely a typing slip than a different person.
